scope: 57 explicitly curated public social-profile URLs in the Idols discovery dataset, not every catalog name.
limitations: Social platform HTTP status does not confirm ownership; account identity was retained only where the artist-controlled YouTube channel description identifies the account as official.
Instagram often timed out; 17 current links remain unconfirmed by direct HTTP response in this environment.
Twitch returned HTTP 405 to HEAD, which is not treated as a broken link.
This audit covers 57 curated social links, not every profile in the wider directory.
